Name: Warp Sickness
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52735/52735-1790112031-907244925.png[/img][/b][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8]Warp Totems and the Return Scepter aren't something you used prior to coming to the Valley. Imagine your surprise when, moments after discovering you can teleport, you also find out you suffer from Warp Sickness.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]When Warping via Totem or Scepter, you gain three debuffs:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Warp Sickness: Speed -3 for 15 seconds.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Darkness: Dim Vision for 15 seconds.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Nausea: Unable to eat for 1 minute.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52735/52735-1790112031-1404583077.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color][/*]
[/list][center][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52735/52735-1790112039-727866533.png[/img][/b][/center]

[list]
[*]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] Warp Sickness [/b]and [b][SMAPI] WarpSickness[/b] to your mods folder.[/*]
[*]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file into your mod manager of choice and install as usual.[/*]
[*]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do![/*]
[/list]
[center][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52735/52735-1790112035-387175553.png[/img][/b][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8]No compatibility issues, but support for mod-added totems is coming![/color]

[center][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52735/52735-1790112038-2128559324.png[/img][/b][/center]
